title: MAW Foundation Error Codes
description: Standard error codes used across Node.js and PHP backends. Both backends must map internal errors to these codes.

SESSION_EXPIRED.description: Session or refresh token has expired

FORBIDDEN.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this action

OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Operation not allowed in current state

FEATURE_DISABLED.description: Feature is disabled for this tenant/plan

ACCOUNT_DISABLED.description: Account has been disabled by admin

RATE_LIMITED.description: Too many requests — try again later

ACCOUNT_LOCKED.description: Account locked due to too many failed attempts

INVALID_OTP.description: OTP/MFA code is invalid or expired

PASSWORD_POLICY.description: Password does not meet policy requirements

ACCOUNT_PENDING_VERIFICATION.description: Account email is not yet verified

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.description: A dependency (e.g. the storage provider) could not complete the request
